description: Add a card to the authenticated user's buy-list, incrementing the quantity (creates the row if absent). This is a real write. Use update_buy_list to set an absolute quantity or remove_buy_list to delete a row. Requires IWMM_API_KEY.

cardId.description: Internal IWMM card UUID. Get from search_cards or get_card.

isFoil.description: Whether this is the foil variant. Foil and non-foil are separate rows. Defaults to false.

quantity.description: How many to add. Defaults to 1.

name: add_buy_list
